acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

grantPausableRole(address).details: Role will be granted to PCS security monitoring integration, so pause can happen the moment any suspicious activity is detected.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pausePoolManager().details: PCS will have security monitoring integration to pause the pool manager in case of any suspicious activity

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

returns._0: the address of the pending pool manager owner

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

transferPoolManagerOwnership(address).details: used when a new PoolManagerOwner contract is created and we transfer pool manager owner to new contract

params.newPoolManagerOwner: the address of the new owner

acceptPoolManagerOwnership().notice: accept the ownership of pool manager, only callable by the pending pool manager owner set by latest transferPoolManagerOwnership

grantPausableRole(address).notice: Grant the pausable role to an account

pausePoolManager().notice: pause pool manager, only owner or account with pausable role can call. Once paused, no swaps, donate or add liquidity are allowed, only remove liquidity is permitted.

pendingPoolManagerOwner().notice: get the current pending pool manager owner

setProtocolFeeController(address).notice: set the protocol fee controller, only owner can call

transferPoolManagerOwnership(address).notice: transfer the ownership of pool manager to the new owner

unpausePoolManager().notice: unpause pool manager, only owner can call
